fields.description:
Route pipeline needs: JSON body parse → auth → rate-limit → 64KB body cap (NTL-215) → store write. Currently jumps straight to store — no auth, no rate-limit, no size guard.

## Definition of done

- Each middleware isolated (`src/server/middleware/*.ts`).
- Failing tests written first (auth-required, rate-limit-exceeded, body-too-large).
- No behavioral change to the success path.

comments.body: Started blocking on this — every new endpoint pays the middleware tax. Nailing it once is worth the wait.
Auth + rate-limit in feat/http-mw. Body-cap deferred to NTL-215 (Riley taking it).
Can you make sure the rate-limit key includes the merchant id? Otherwise we throttle the wrong tenant.
Done. Rate-limit key is `${merchantId}:${route}`. Merging feat/http-mw after body-cap lands.
